answer: Each identity enrolls a keystroke-timing profile: dwell time and flight time between keys, measured as it types, so one operator's hands leave the same ripple across every fake. Matching profiles cluster as one island; only the first stands, the rest fall off the ledge. Three matches trigger enforcement: each fake's 25.000 POA bond is seized, half burned, half to the reporter, and the key is banned 12 epochs. Forging 1.000 fakes costs 1.000 x 25.000 = 25.000.000 POA; an honest agent stakes 25.000 POA once. Limitation: agents that dictate or paste answers leave no keystroke signal.
